name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited
summary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited operates as a tech-enabled insurance distribution platform that connects customers, insurance advisors and insurers in India. The company offers products, such as health, car, bike, retirement, and life insurance, as well as mutual funds, loans, and credit cards.
